data.one_liner: A simple widget to create ripple animation effects by wrapping other widgets.
data.what_it_does: RippleWave is a Flutter package that wraps around existing widgets to create a customizable ripple animation. It allows configuring wave count, colors, child tweens, and manual animation control via an AnimationController.
use_when: You need to display a ripple animation around a button, icon, or other widget.
You want a simple wave effect without setting up complex custom animations.
avoid_when: You need complex vector animations like Rive or Lottie.
You require advanced physics-based motion transitions.
strengths: Easy to use by wrapping widgets directly.
Supports custom animation controllers and tween effects.
weaknesses: Limited in scope to a single type of ripple effect.
Minimal documentation outside of basic usage examples.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you need a comprehensive and flexible animation library for a wide range of visual effects.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you prefer pre-made vector animations designed by professional animators.

data.minimal_example:
RippleWave(
  color: Colors.green,
  repeat: false,
  child: const Icon(
    Icons.emoji_emotions,
    size: 100,
    color: Colors.white,
  ),
)
